# stats.ttest.fmri_ttest { #fmrimod.stats.ttest.fmri_ttest }

```python
fmri_ttest(
    data,
    *,
    engine='auto',
    formula='~ 1',
    method='pm',
    weights='ivw',
    weights_custom=None,
    effect_cols=None,
)
```

Run a parity-oriented one-sample group t-test.

``data`` may be a frozen `GroupData` or a pandas DataFrame
(validated and converted to a frozen ``GroupData`` at entry via the
typed `group_data_from_csv`; pass its ``effect_cols`` schema).

Current slice:
- CSV-backed GroupData only
- one-sample inference around zero (``formula='~ 1'``)
